sheets.prompt: Character design reference sheet for a science fiction exploration game: one grunt, a small stocky monster, drawn four times side by side at the same scale on a plain cream background: front view, side view, three-quarter view, and its attack wind-up with a crude club raised over its head in both hands. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade backpack stands beside it for scale; the grunt is 1.3 metres tall, a little shorter than the traveller. Design: human proportions and joints, a big head with a wide flat snout, two small tusks, long pointed ears and small bright eyes, a round belly, short bandy legs, three-toed feet; smooth tomato-red skin, the base colour of its kind; a simple loincloth and one leather strap across the chest; a knobbly wooden club. Mischievous and dim, more comic than frightening. Original design, medium detail, a strong readable silhouette. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, cream paper grain, evenly spaced views, fully visible bodies, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, lettering, labels, scenery, hollow knight, white mask, drapes, bandages, mummy, robes, gore.
